sloka: स ददर्श आसने रामः निषण्णम् पितरम् शुभे ।कैकेयी सहितम् दीनम् मुखेन परिशुष्यता ॥२-१८-१॥
transliteration: sa dadarśa āsane rāmaḥ niṣaṇṇam pitaram śubhe ।kaikeyī sahitam dīnam mukhena pariśuṣyatā ॥2-18-1॥

translations.english: Rama beheld his father reclined on an auspicious couch and by his side was seated Kaikeyi. He looked wretched with a pale face.
